reference.description: A1 range to view, sheet-qualified where needed (e.g. "'LBO Model'!B40:N80"). A single cell is allowed.

show.description: What each cell renders. 'value' (default): formatted display values; a † marks a number whose format hides that it is numeric (a date, an accounting dash) — a legend below the grid explains it. 'rawValue': underlying unformatted values. 'fontColor'/'fill'/'numberFormat': that style property ('-' when unset; colors as lowercase hex for RGB, raw token for theme/preset/indexed colors). 'formula': formula cells render a short key like [1] with a legend below the grid; text results appear alongside the key (e.g. Units sold [1]) — formulas are compared in R1C1 form, so a formula filled across a range shares one key and anomalies stand out; non-formula cells show their raw value, so hardcoded overrides stand out too.
